headline: WTI Crude Falls 6.13 Percent To 97.31 From A Prior Close Of 103.66
narrative: Crude oil last traded at 97.31, down 6.13 percent from a prior close of 103.66, after the session fell as low as 95.25. Natural gas fell 2.62 percent to 2.98, so the energy pipe is releasing price in both crude and gas. Silver rose 1.63 percent to 57.90 and copper rose 0.87 percent to 6.595, so the industrial-metal pipes are the ones still receiving a bid.
author: jordan
